name: lens-plano-concave
description: A lens cross-section with one flat surface and one inward-curving surface.
useCase: Identify a plano-concave lens in an optical component selector.
misuse: Use a label to name the component; this symbol is not a scaled optical drawing.

16.reason: The two surfaces form a single closed contour, with enough inner space to distinguish flat and curved faces.

24.reason: The curved surface and clear interior stay balanced against the flat or opposing curved face within the square drawing frame.
